name: Jev for Grok Bot
one_line_desc: Connects a Jev decision seat to Grok Bot using one OpenRouter or TypeSafe API key, so process decisions come back faster and the Bot can drive a headed browser on its own machine.

name: Schoolbag
one_line_desc: Reads the school inbox and calendar you connect and surfaces what is due, from forms and permission slips to signatures and field trips.

name: Ad Aether
one_line_desc: An inbox triage bot for creators about to go live, added in one tap. It works through the mailbox and comes back with a single next move instead of another layer of barriers.

name: Travel Influencer Outreach
one_line_desc: Drafts and sends pitches to hotels, tourism boards, and travel brands for stay-for-content deals, follows the reply threads, and plans demo Reels for travel creators.

name: Texas Pro Se Legal Matters
one_line_desc: Organises Texas district, appellate, and Supreme Court matters for self-represented filers with dockets, deadline tracking, filing nudges, and a document shelf.

name: Large Event Ops Bot
one_line_desc: Coordinates large events end to end: partner inbox, gift and food commitments, day-of operations sheets, and quiet deadline reminders for the team.

name: Done
one_line_desc: Compares, books or orders, confirms, and calendars day-to-day errands, then returns a single proof line. It asks first for anything involving money or outbound messages.

name: Orbit brief
one_line_desc: A daily brief written in French covering SpaceX and Starship, xAI and Grok Bot, and orbital architecture and debris, with five sourced facts and three concrete actions.

name: Daili
one_line_desc: Sends a short morning brief with calendar, weather, important mail, and any live connectors you have set up, and a weekly outlook on a day you choose.

name: Argonaut
one_line_desc: Finds sibling epic threads in the #argonaut multiverse on X, appends exactly one line, then hops to the next branch so the saga keeps branching instead of settling on a single canon.

name: LinkedIn Lead Outreach
one_line_desc: Tracks commenters on founder lead magnets in Notion, replies to them, moves interested ones to DM for an email, and accepts connections inside review-friendly caps.

name: CEO Morning Secretary
one_line_desc: Produces a weekday morning brief in English for a non-technical CEO, covering the calendar and the day's context, written in chat and then spoken out loud.

name: Summarize Bot
one_line_desc: Point it at a link, video, podcast, or file and it returns a short gist in chat through the summarize CLI. It runs on demand and does not invent content when the CLI is unavailable.

name: Moving Concierge
one_line_desc: Advises callers and chat users on moving, from packing and truck rental to storage, helping them choose DIY, full-service, or hybrid and leaving a clear next step.

name: X Agent
one_line_desc: Watches AI and coding conversations on X, drafts replies that sound like you, and waits for your approval before anything goes out, so you keep the mic.

name: Grok Telegram
one_line_desc: Walks you from a BotFather token to a live Grok Bot answering Telegram DMs over a no-LLM webhook bridge, with a Cloudflare Tunnel as an optional piece.

name: Mike
one_line_desc: Monitors your school parent inbox and personal Gmail, flags what matters, and asks before adding anything to your family calendar.

name: Press
one_line_desc: Takes a confirmed draft, runs a professional QC pass on it, gets your final approval, posts it on x.com, and shows proof that it went out.

name: Tesla Solar/Vehicles Charging Coach
one_line_desc: A read-only coach for homes running Tesla solar with Powerwall, working from flat or time-of-use rates and an optional Tessie connection that turns recent drives into a three-day plan.

name: Lead Scout
one_line_desc: Pulls local small businesses that have public websites and likely SEO, AEO, or GEO gaps, then hands short dossiers to a research teammate. Built for cold-outreach work.

name: Site Research
one_line_desc: Expands local-business lead dossiers into gap briefs with supporting evidence for a draft seat. It does not email, pitch, or scout leads itself.

name: Terminator
one_line_desc: Reviews your Grok Bot roster and recommends which bots to keep, merge, replace, or retire, showing evidence for each call and changing nothing until you say yes.

name: X Hygiene
one_line_desc: Estimates the cost first, then builds ranked block and unfollow lists with profile links for cleaning up your X followers and following, within weekly, monthly, and per-run caps you set.

name: flow-writer
one_line_desc: Builds flowcharts from your description. The first run asks you to accept the author's AI agent disclaimer before any diagram work begins.

name: Fulcrum
one_line_desc: On weekdays, or whenever asked, surfaces a short ranked list of high-value reply, quote, and thread opportunities on X and drafts responses without publishing anything.

name: Plant Field OS
one_line_desc: A field sales system for reps: a daily planning cockpit, an installed-base map, a free site audit that trains the rep, and a lightweight leadership dashboard.

name: Brainnovation Intake
one_line_desc: Delivers a simplified Creative Thinking Snapshot intake in chat: a warm start, four scenarios, a clear result, and a short bridge into the six-step cycle.

name: Deal Finder Ops
one_line_desc: Tests coupon codes and compares deals by what the cart actually charges, then shows what was tested with price, seller, and terms. It does not count an untested code as working.

name: Elon Bot
one_line_desc: Coordinates discretionary and mean-reversion trader bots on a paper-trading desk, runs digests and thesis alerts, and scores an A/B contest between the seats.

name: Momentum
one_line_desc: Watches a multi-agent workspace for lanes that have stalled, nudges quiet specialists, and packages the next zero-spend moves for your approval.

name: Family Cookbook
one_line_desc: Collects a home cook's Facebook cooking posts and turns them into a gift-quality living cookbook PDF with story titles, food photos, and clickable contents and indexes.

name: LearnBot
one_line_desc: Explains a single engineering term each day in language aimed at non-technical readers, with options to learn more in different formats.

name: Restaurant Order Recovery
one_line_desc: Finds canceled delivery orders and error charges inside your own merchant portals and files reimbursement requests, running a daily reclaim pass.

name: Reputation Scrub Specialist
one_line_desc: Helps people remove their details from people-search and data-broker sites after consent, drafting the opt-outs and tracking each one through to completion.

name: Mint your Grok Bots
one_line_desc: A beta experiment from the author with no guarantees: it guides you through naming a Grok Bot, choosing an avatar, and minting an identity NFT on Polygon mainnet that stays yours.

name: Tiffany
one_line_desc: Handles trade operations for pool and plumbing work: customers, jobs, quotes, suppliers, stock, invoice audits, supplier price checks, and receivables follow-ups.

name: RV Trip Planner
one_line_desc: Plans multi-day RV trips for full-timers, builds a trip board in chat, checks live availability, and prepares bookings for your review and payment.

name: Last Stop
one_line_desc: Keeps a public map of Grok Bots, scans catalogs when asked, maintains a known-bots wiki, and turns each new find's method into a skill instead of copying another bot's text.

name: Piper
one_line_desc: Once the org schema is confirmed, it stands up or migrates the event-log store and extracts, canonizes, and loads logs from the connected sources.

name: Mat
one_line_desc: Answers questions with reports or charts built on a confirmed org schema and event logs. Read-only, it does not change the underlying model.

name: Arnie
one_line_desc: Converts a bottleneck diagnosis or workshop decision into an exact ontology patch, then waits for your approval before anything is applied.

name: Dig
one_line_desc: Produces org briefings at the right altitude, from daily team standups through weekly team, monthly department, quarterly board, and yearly shareholder summaries.

name: A3
one_line_desc: Coaches operators and non-engineers through the eight-step A3 and DMAIC loop using real data or explicit unknowns, working root causes rather than jumping to fixes.

name: Jev
one_line_desc: A typed decision seat for TypeSafe Jev covering categorize, yes-no, and severity calls. It assumes Jev is already wired in through LiteLLM.

name: INDEXX
one_line_desc: Builds a searchable local wiki from your Instagram Saved posts on a Mac, keeping the media on your computer while transcription and optional analysis run in the cloud.

name: Iron Gate
one_line_desc: A devil's-advocate bot that steelmans the case against big go/no-go calls, grades its own objection, and never acts on your behalf.

name: anew
one_line_desc: free webpages
note: Live (200) but the bot's own description is only 'free webpages' - not enough to state what it does, so deliberately left out of bots.json per the no-padding rule.

name: Speed Lab
one_line_desc: Runs an autoresearch loop over top-ranked render-speed techniques and keeps only the changes with measured LCP wins.

name: Pain in the Task
one_line_desc: Interviews you about a repetitive task, diagnoses the real workflow, then prescribes and stands up the right kind of help.
note: Marketplace share ID is an alternate link for an existing listing; same bot, do not add as a new entry.

name: Bouncer
one_line_desc: Reviews a public Grok Bot share link or pasted config before you add it and returns CLEAN, WARN, or BLOCK-recommended.
